title: Localization on an ambient affine open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L$ an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], $s\in\Gamma(X,L)$ and $F$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $S\subseteq X$ be an open with underlying set the nonvanishing locus $X_s$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], and let $U\subseteq X$ be affine open. For $p\geq0$, write $A_p(W)=H^p(W,F)$ for open module cohomology [def-sc-open-module-cohomology] and $Q_p(U)$ for the additive fraction presentation [def-sc-cohomology-fraction-presentation], whose generator $[n,\xi]$ has $\xi\in H^p(U,F\otimes L^{\otimes n})$ and whose relations are $[n,\xi]=[n+b,s^b\xi]$. For every $p\geq0$, There is an additive isomorphism $e_p:Q_p(U)\longrightarrow A_p(U\cap S)$ such that, for every $n\geq0$ and every numerator $\xi$, multiplication of $e_p([n,\xi])$ by $s^n$ is the restriction of $\xi$ from $U$ to $U\cap S$. Multiplication here is induced on cohomology by the module morphism $F\cong F\otimes\mathcal O_X\xrightarrow{1\otimes s^n}F\otimes L^{\otimes n}$.

source.place: Tags 09MR (degree-zero and affine-open paragraphs), 01PW, and 01E1 (2); consulted at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09MR, /01PW and /01E1

proof.text: For p>0, affine_cap_section_open identifies U cap S with an affine open V, by extensionality and the equality defining S.

Each F tensor L.tensorPow n is quasi-coherent by the already proved WeilConjectures declaration isQuasicoherent_tensorObj F (L.tensorPow n). Apply affine-open vanishing to every numerator on U, to F on U cap S, and to each twist on U cap S.

A direct sum of subsingleton groups is subsingleton. Quotient induction then makes its fraction quotient subsingleton. Define the additive equivalence between the zero source and target groups by the constant zero maps in both directions. Its inverse identities, additivity and the numerator formula follow from subsingleton elimination in the relevant groups.
